question: Who among the following is the author of 'Being Gandhi'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paro Anand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• The book Being Gandhi was written by award-winning author **Paro Anand.**
 
• The book was l**aunched on 2nd Oct 2019** to mark the 150th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.<
